compatible_suite_sha256.877e009f6d24b4d84724b5160a2fb7afd52b57b7: Original suite before strict typing annotations; all 105 tasks and benchmark constants are identical. Retained for grading archived results.

ground_truth: Synthetic labels created for this benchmark; not independently human-annotated. Previously used in GLiNER comparison; no Laya-specific tuning.
score_metrics: argmax level accuracy and probability-weighted score MAE on 0..4 scale; subjective coarse rubric
primary: All cases, excluding six predeclared ambiguous or contradictory individual judgments; original-label full results also retained
entities_and_records: Verification of provided candidates, not unconstrained extraction. Candidate sets include ground truth.

exclusions.route_11/confirm: Prompt explicitly lists deploying as requiring confirmation, but legacy label exempts staging without stating that exemption.
exclusions.cond_02/cond_mentions_deadline: Before renewal is a timeframe for action under the actual question, despite legacy negative label.
exclusions.rec_07/neg_1: Text says Amara sold a bread machine to a neighbor; this entails the neighbor acquired it, contradicting negative label.
exclusions.rec_10/neg_1: Same model tent versus tent model is a defensible paraphrase; negative label is ambiguous.
exclusions.rec_12/neg_1: Pair question asks whether tourists bought mug, which the text supports; it does not ask for an individually identified buyer.
exclusions.ver_05/supported: HR enrollment and active deductions support enrollment; pending carrier confirmation makes the binary gold interpretation debatable.

limits: Directional application smoke benchmark, not production validation
Small correlated sample; no claim of general calibration reliability
Root English only; no multilingual or typed-decisions checkpoint comparison
